Sample too small
Based on 0 eligible sharp rosters. That is below the 8-roster minimum, so these percentages are not ranked as meaningful results.
No market comparison available
No general-dynasty roster-percentage feed is ingested by this platform, so sharp-vs-market advantage is unavailable. Every ranking source we ingest publishes values or ranks, and Sleeper's trending endpoint publishes 24-hour add counts — a flow, not an ownership rate. Those columns stay null rather than estimated.
Most rostered by sharps
0 qualifying players · updated —
Collecting sharp rosters
The sharp cohort is known, but its rosters have not been collected yet. Run the sharp roster crawl to populate this board.
A high roster percentage is not a buy signal on its own. Elite players are rostered almost everywhere, and ownership is also shaped by league depth, format, acquisition cost, age and positional scarcity. Rows marked * rest on a small denominator.

Qualification guardrail
Automated managers passed the unchanged Sharp Score v2 evidence gates. Curated FFPC high-stakes managers and provisional public FFPC observations are separately labeled methods with configured weights. Provisional activity can populate the market table, but it is never presented as sharp-v2 qualification. Name-only or league-scoped FFPC identities cannot satisfy automated multi-league qualification.
